# Erik Demaine

> Portfolio of a MIT computer scientist exploring the intersection of algorithms, geometry, and artistic practice through research, teaching, and collaborative sculpture with Martin Demaine.

Erik Demaine is a renowned computer scientist at MIT specializing in computational geometry, with a parallel practice in mathematical art and curved-crease sculpture. The site showcases both academic research and collaborative artistic works with his father Martin Demaine, spanning publications, courses, exhibitions, and interactive digital projects.

## Key Topics

- curved-crease sculpture
- computational geometry
- origami algorithms
- mathematical art
- paper folding
- MIT courses
- puzzle design
- geometric folding
- paper sculpture
- interactive typography
- deployable structures
- glass blowing
- MoMA collections
- computational complexity

## Teaching & Education

- [Erik Demaine's Classes](https://erikdemaine.org/classes): MIT computer science courses on algorithms and data structures by Erik Demaine

## Research & Publications

- [Geometric Folding Algorithms: Linkages, Origami, Polyhedra](https://erikdemaine.org/papers/GFALOP): Research monograph on geometric folding algorithms by Demaine and O'Rourke
- [Games, Puzzles, and Computation](https://erikdemaine.org/papers/GPC): Book on computational complexity of games and puzzles by Hearn and Demaine
- [Tribute to a Mathemagician](https://erikdemaine.org/papers/Gardner5): Edited collection honoring Martin Gardner by Cipra, Demaines, and Rodgers
- [A Lifetime of Puzzles](https://erikdemaine.org/papers/Gardner90): Edited puzzle collection by Demaines and Rodgers

## Curved-Crease Sculpture

- [Curved-Crease Sculpture by Erik and Martin Demaine](https://erikdemaine.org/curved): Curved-crease paper sculpture series by Erik and Martin Demaine
- [Computational Origami (2008): MoMA Collection](https://erikdemaine.org/curved/MoMA): MoMA-collected curved-crease sculptures in Design and the Elastic Mind
- [Destructors (2013-2015)](https://erikdemaine.org/curved/Destructors): Text-based curved-crease book sculpture series by Demaines
- [Curved Crease Sculpture (2012)](https://erikdemaine.org/curved/GuidedByInvoices): 2012 curved-crease sculpture exhibition by Erik and Martin Demaine

## Film & Multimedia

- [Film & Video by Erik Demaine](https://erikdemaine.org/film): Films and videos on mathematics, geometry, and crafts by Erik Demaine
- [Lino Tagliapietra: Glass Magician](https://erikdemaine.org/film/glassmagician): Documentary film on glass artist Lino Tagliapietra by Demaines

## Interactive Typography & Fonts

- [Mathematical and Puzzle Fonts/Typefaces](https://erikdemaine.org/fonts): Collection of mathematical and puzzle-based fonts by Demaines
- [Linkage Font](https://erikdemaine.org/fonts/linkage): Interactive font based on fixed-angle linkage mechanisms
- [Penland Glass Squishing Font](https://erikdemaine.org/fonts/squish): Interactive glass-blowing inspired animated font
- [Conveyer Belt Font](https://erikdemaine.org/fonts/conveyer): Interactive conveyer belt-based puzzle font

## Exhibitions & Events

- [Upcoming Events by Erik Demaine](https://erikdemaine.org/upcoming): Upcoming exhibitions and events featuring Erik and Martin Demaine's art

## Optional

- [3D QR Codes](https://erikdemaine.org/prints/QR): Layered 3D QR codes combining algorithmic design with physical art
